     1→<!DOCTYPE html>
     2→<html lang="id">
     3→<head>
     4→<meta charset="UTF-8" />
     5→<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1" />
     6→<title>SIMANTAP — Situs Mandiri Terintegrasi Aplikasi Pembelajaran</title>
     7→<meta name="description" content="SIMANTAP: kelola pembelajaran, nilai, kuis, dan laporan hasil belajar siswa — untuk guru, siswa, dan orang tua." />
     8→<style>
     9→@font-face { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans'; font-weight:400; font-style:normal; font-display:swap; src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2'); }
    10→@font-face { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans'; font-weight:500; font-style:normal; font-display:swap; src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2'); }
    11→@font-face { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans'; font-weight:600; font-style:normal; font-display:swap; src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2'); }
    12→@font-face { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans'; font-weight:700; font-style:normal; font-display:swap; src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2'); }
    13→@font-face { font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans'; font-weight:800; font-style:normal; font-display:swap; src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2'); }
    14→
    15→:root{
    16→  --navy:#1F3864; --navy-2:#152847; --navy-3:#0E1C33;
    17→  --gold:#B8860B; --gold-2:#D4A017; --gold-soft:#F4E7C8;
    18→  --bg:#F3F5F9; --surface:#FFFFFF; --surface-2:#F8F9FC;
    19→  --ink:#1B2430; --ink-2:#3B4453; --muted:#6B7686; --faint:#98A1AF;
    20→  --border:#E3E7EE; --border-2:#EDF0F5;
    21→  --ok:#1F7A4C; --ok-bg:#E7F5EC;
    22→  --bad:#B3261E; --bad-bg:#FBEAE9;
    23→  --warn:#9A6B00; --warn-bg:#FDF3DC;
    24→  --info:#1D5AA6; --info-bg:#E8F1FB;
    25→  --radius-sm:8px; --radius:12px; --radius-lg:18px;
    26→  --shadow-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.06), 0 1px 1px rgba(15,23,42,.04);
    27→  --shadow-md:0 8px 24px rgba(15,35,70,.10), 0 2px 6px rgba(15,35,70,.06);
    28→  --shadow-lg:0 20px 48px rgba(15,35,70,.16);
    29→  --sidebar-w:264px;
    30→  --font:'Plus Jakarta Sans','Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
    31→}
    32→
    33→*,*::before,*::after{ box-sizing:border-box; }
    34→html,body{ height:100%; }
    35→body{
    36→  margin:0; font-family:var(--font); color:var(--ink); background:var(--bg);
    37→  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased; text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
    38→  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
    39→}
    40→h1,h2,h3,h4{ margin:0; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-.01em; color:var(--navy); }
    41→p{ margin:0; }
    42→button{ font-family:inherit; }
    43→a{ color:inherit; }
    44→::selection{ background:var(--gold-soft); }
    45→
    46→.hidden{ display:none !important; }
    47→.scr{ position:absolute; width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0; }
    48→
    49→/* ---------- Scrollbar ---------- */
    50→::-webkit-scrollbar{ width:10px; height:10px; }
    51→::-webkit-scrollbar-track{ background:transparent; }
    52→::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{ background:#C7CEDA; border-radius:20px; border:2px solid var(--bg); }
    53→
    54→/* ============================================================
    55→   LAYAR PENUH (setup / login)
    56→   ============================================================ */
    57→.full-screen{
    58→  min-height:100vh; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    59→  background:
    60→    radial-gradient(1100px 520px at 12% -10%, #24447B 0%, transparent 60%),
    61→    radial-gradient(900px 500px at 105% 10%, #142845 0%, transparent 55%),
    62→    linear-gradient(160deg, var(--navy-3), var(--navy) 55%, var(--navy-2));
    63→  padding:32px 20px; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
    64→}
    65→.full-screen::before{
    66→  content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:.5; pointer-events:none;
    67→  background-image:
    68→    repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255,255,255,.035) 0 1px, transparent 1px 64px);
    69→}
    70→.brand-orb{
    71→  position:absolute; width:520px; height:520px; border-radius:50%;
    72→  border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,.18); right:-160px; bottom:-180px; pointer-events:none;
    73→}
    74→.brand-orb::after{
    75→  content:''; position:absolute; inset:60px; border-radius:50%; border:1px solid rgba(212,160,23,.14);
    76→}
    77→.auth-card{
    78→  position:relative; z-index:1; width:100%; max-width:440px; background:var(--surface);
    79→  border-radius:var(--radius-lg); box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg); padding:38px 34px 30px; 
    80→}
    81→.auth-mark{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin-bottom:22px; }
    82→.auth-mark .ring{
    83→  width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%; flex:0 0 auto;
    84→  background:conic-gradient(from -40deg, var(--gold) 0deg, var(--gold-2) 110deg, var(--navy) 111deg, var(--navy) 360deg);
    85→  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    86→}
    87→.auth-mark .ring span{
    88→  width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--navy); color:var(--gold-2);
    89→  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-weight:800; font-size:13px;
    90→}
    91→.auth-mark .word b{ display:block; font-size:19px; letter-spacing:.02em; color:var(--navy); line-height:1.1; }
    92→.auth-mark .word small{ display:block; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.01em; }
    93→
    94→.auth-title{ font-size:22px; margin-bottom:4px; }
    95→.auth-sub{ color:var(--muted); font-size:13.5px; margin-bottom:24px; line-height:1.5; }
    96→
    97→.field{ margin-bottom:16px; }
    98→.field label{ display:block; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-2); margin-bottom:6px; letter-spacing:.01em; }
    99→.field input, .field select, .field textarea{
   100→  width:100%; border:1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius-sm); padding:11px 13px;
   101→  font-size:14.5px; font-family:inherit; color:var(--ink); background:var(--surface-2); transition:border-color .15s, background .15s;
   102→}
   103→.field input:focus, .field select:focus, .field textarea:focus{
   104→  outline:none; border-color:var(--navy); background:var(--surface); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(31,56,100,.10);
   105→}
   106→.field-hint{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--faint); margin-top:5px; }
   107→.field-row{ display:flex; gap:12px; }
   108→.field-row .field{ flex:1; }
   109→
   110→.btn{
   111→  appearance:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; font-family:inherit; font-weight:700; font-size:14px;
   112→  border-radius:var(--radius-sm); padding:11px 18px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px;
   113→  transition:transform .08s ease, box-shadow .15s, background .15s, opacity .15s; letter-spacing:.01em;
   114→}
   115→.btn:active{ transform:translateY(1px); }
   116→.btn-primary{ background:var(--navy); color:#fff; box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); }
   117→.btn-primary:hover{ background:var(--navy-2); }
   118→.btn-gold{ background:var(--gold); color:#fff; }
   119→.btn-gold:hover{ background:#9C7209; }
   120→.btn-ghost{ background:transparent; color:var(--navy); border:1.5px solid var(--border); }
   121→.btn-ghost:hover{ background:var(--surface-2); }
   122→.btn-danger{ background:var(--bad-bg); color:var(--bad); }
   123→.btn-danger:hover{ background:#F6D9D7; }
   124→.btn-sm{ padding:7px 12px; font-size:12.5px; border-radius:7px; }
   125→.btn-block{ width:100%; }
   126→.btn:disabled{ opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed; }
   127→.btn-icon{ padding:8px; border-radius:8px; }
   128→
   129→.auth-error{
   130→  background:var(--bad-bg); color:var(--bad); border-radius:var(--radius-sm); padding:10px 12px;
   131→  font-size:13px; margin-bottom:16px; display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:flex-start; line-height:1.4;
   132→}
   133→.auth-foot{ margin-top:18px; text-align:center; font-size:12px; color:var(--faint); }
   134→.auth-switch{ text-align:center; margin-top:16px; font-size:13px; color:var(--muted); }
   135→.auth-switch button{ background:none; border:none; color:var(--navy); font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; text-decoration:underline; font-size:13px; }
   136→
   137→.setup-info{
   138→  background:var(--info-bg); color:#123A63; border-radius:var(--radius-sm); padding:12px 14px; font-size:12.5px;
   139→  line-height:1.55; margin-bottom:18px;
   140→}
   141→.setup-info b{ display:block; margin-bottom:3px; }
   142→.setup-steps{ margin:0 0 0 18px; padding:0; }
   143→.setup-steps li{ margin-bottom:4px; }
   144→
   145→/* ============================================================
   146→   APP SHELL
   147→   ============================================================ */
   148→.app-shell{ display:flex; min-height:100vh; }
   149→
   150→.sidebar{
   151→  width:var(--sidebar-w); flex:0 0 auto; background:linear-gradient(185deg, var(--navy-3), var(--navy) 60%, var(--navy-2));
   152→  color:#EAF0FB; display:flex; flex-direction:column; position:sticky; top:0; height:100vh; z-index:20;
   153→}
   154→.sb-brand{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:20px 20px 16px; }
   155→.sb-brand .ring{ width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%; background:conic-gradient(from -40deg, var(--gold) 0deg, var(--gold-2) 110deg, #fff0 111deg, #fff0 360deg); display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center; flex:0 0 auto;}
   156→.sb-brand .ring span{ width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%; background:var(--navy-3); color:var(--gold-2); display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center; font-weight:800; font-size:11px; }
   157→.sb-brand b{ display:block; font-size:15.5px; letter-spacing:.02em; }
   158→.sb-brand small{ display:block; font-size:10.5px; color:#9FB2D6; font-weight:600; }
   159→
   160→.sb-school{ margin:0 16px 14px; padding:10px 12px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); border-radius:10px; font-size:11.5px; color:#C4D2EA; line-height:1.4; }
   161→.sb-school b{ display:block; color:#fff; font-size:12.5px; margin-bottom:1px; }
   162→
   163→.sb-nav{ flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:6px 12px 12px; }
   164→.sb-section{ font-size:10.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.08em; color:#7C93BE; font-weight:700; margin:16px 10px 6px; }
   165→.sb-link{
   166→  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:10px; color:#D6E0F2; text-decoration:none;
   167→  font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; margin-bottom:2px; border:none; background:none; width:100%; text-align:left;
   168→}
   169→.sb-link svg{ flex:0 0 auto; opacity:.85; }
   170→.sb-link:hover{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.08); color:#fff; }
   171→.sb-link.active{ background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(212,160,23,.22), rgba(212,160,23,.06)); color:#fff; box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--gold-2); }
   172→.sb-link .badge{ margin-left:auto; background:var(--gold-2); color:#3A2A00; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:800; padding:1.5px 7px; border-radius:20px; }
   173→
   174→.sb-foot{ padding:14px; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); }
   175→.sb-user{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:8px 8px; border-radius:10px; }
   176→.sb-user .av{ width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%; background:rgba(212,160,23,.22); color:var(--gold-2); display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center; font-weight:800; font-size:13px; flex:0 0 auto; }
   177→.sb-user .who b{ display:block; font-size:12.5px; color:#fff; line-height:1.25; }
   178→.sb-user .who small{ display:block; font-size:10.5px; color:#9FB2D6; text-transform:capitalize; }
   179→.sb-foot-actions{ display:flex; gap:6px; margin-top:10px; }
   180→.sb-foot-actions button{ flex:1; background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); color:#D6E0F2; border:none; border-radius:8px; padding:7px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:5px; }
   181→.sb-foot-actions button:hover{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.14); color:#fff; }
   182→
   183→.main{ flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
   184→.topbar{
   185→  position:sticky; top:0; z-index:15; background:rgba(243,245,249,.88); backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
   186→  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); padding:14px 26px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; min-height:64px;
   187→}
   188→.topbar h1{ font-size:19px; }
   189→.topbar .sub{ font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:1px; }
   190→.topbar .spacer{ flex:1; }
   191→.menu-toggle{ display:none; background:none; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; padding:8px; cursor:pointer; }
   192→
   193→.content{ padding:22px 26px 60px; flex:1; }
   194→.content-narrow{ max-width:960px; }
   195→
   196→/* ============================================================
   197→   COMPONENTS
   198→   ============================================================ */
   199→.card{ background:var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); }
   200→.card-pad{ padding:20px 22px; }
   201→.card-head{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:18px 22px 0; }
   202→.card-head h3{ font-size:15.5px; }
   203→.card-head .desc{ font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; }
   204→.card-head .spacer{ flex:1; }
   205→
   206→.grid{ display:grid; gap:16px; }
   207→.grid-4{ grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); }
   208→.grid-3{ grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); }
   209→.grid-2{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); }
   210→@media (max-width:1100px){ .grid-4{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);} .grid-3{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);} }
   211→@media (max-width:640px){ .grid-4,.grid-3,.grid-2{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
   212→
   213→.kpi{ padding:18px 20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; position:relative; overflow:hidden; }
   214→.kpi .icn{ width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:9px; display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center; }
   215→.kpi .val{ font-size:26px; font-weight:800; color:var(--navy); line-height:1; }
   216→.kpi .lbl{ font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:600; }
   217→.kpi .trend{ font-size:11px; font-weight:700; }
   218→
   219→.tone-navy{ background:#E9EEF7; color:var(--navy); }
   220→.tone-gold{ background:var(--gold-soft); color:var(--warn); }
   221→.tone-ok{ background:var(--ok-bg); color:var(--ok); }
   222→.tone-bad{ background:var(--bad-bg); color:var(--bad); }
   223→.tone-info{ background:var(--info-bg); color:var(--info); }
   224→
   225→.pill{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:3px 10px; border-radius:20px; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; }
   226→.pill-ok{ background:var(--ok-bg); color:var(--ok); }
   227→.pill-bad{ background:var(--bad-bg); color:var(--bad); }
   228→.pill-warn{ background:var(--warn-bg); color:var(--warn); }
   229→.pill-info{ background:var(--info-bg); color:var(--info); }
   230→.pill-muted{ background:var(--border-2); color:var(--muted); }
   231→
   232→table{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:13.5px; }
   233→thead th{ text-align:left; font-size:11px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.05em; color:var(--muted); font-weight:700; padding:9px 12px; border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--border); white-space:nowrap; }
   234→tbody td{ padding:10px 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-2); color:var(--ink-2); }
   235→tbody tr:hover{ background:var(--surface-2); }
   236→tbody tr:last-child td{ border-bottom:none; }
   237→.table-wrap{ overflow-x:auto; }
   238→.table-wrap table input, .table-wrap table select{ width:100%; border:1.3px solid var(--border); border-radius:6px; padding:6px 8px; font-size:13px; font-family:inherit; background:var(--surface); }
   239→.table-actions{ display:flex; gap:6px; }
   240→.avatar-name{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; }
   241→.avatar-name .dot{ width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%; background:var(--navy); color:#fff; font-size:11px; font-weight:800; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex:0 0 auto; }
   242→
   243→.toolbar{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:16px; }
   244→.toolbar .spacer{ flex:1; }
   245→.select-chip select, .select-chip input{ border:1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius:9px; padding:9px 12px; font-size:13.5px; font-family:inherit; background:var(--surface); }
   246→.search-box{ position:relative; }
   247→.search-box input{ padding-left:34px !important; }
   248→.search-box svg{ position:absolute; left:11px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); opacity:.5; }
   249→
   250→.empty-state{ text-align:center; padding:48px 20px; color:var(--muted); }
   251→.empty-state svg{ opacity:.35; margin-bottom:10px; }
   252→.empty-state h4{ color:var(--ink-2); font-size:14.5px; margin-bottom:4px; }
   253→.empty-state p{ font-size:12.5px; max-width:340px; margin:0 auto; }
   254→
   255→.tabs{ display:flex; gap:4px; border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--border); margin-bottom:18px; overflow-x:auto; }
   256→.tab-btn{ background:none; border:none; padding:10px 16px; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer; border-bottom:2.5px solid transparent; white-space:nowrap; }
   257→.tab-btn:hover{ color:var(--ink); }
   258→.tab-btn.active{ color:var(--navy); border-color:var(--gold); }
   259→
   260→/* ring gauge */
   261→.ring-gauge{ position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
   262→.ring-gauge svg{ transform:rotate(-90deg); }
   263→.ring-gauge .center{ position:absolute; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
   264→.ring-gauge .center b{ font-size:18px; color:var(--navy); line-height:1; }
   265→.ring-gauge .center small{ font-size:9.5px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:700; }
   266→
   267→/* Modal */
   268→.modal-backdrop{ position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(14,20,35,.5); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; z-index:100; padding:20px; backdrop-filter:blur(2px); }
   269→.modal{ background:var(--surface); border-radius:var(--radius-lg); width:100%; max-width:560px; max-height:88vh; overflow-y:auto; box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg); }
   270→.modal.modal-wide{ max-width:820px; }
   271→.modal-head{ display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; padding:20px 22px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); position:sticky; top:0; background:var(--surface); z-index:2; }
   272→.modal-head h3{ font-size:16.5px; }
   273→.modal-head .desc{ font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:2px; }
   274→.modal-close{ margin-left:auto; background:var(--surface-2); border:none; border-radius:8px; width:30px; height:30px; cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:var(--muted); }
   275→.modal-body{ padding:20px 22px; }
   276→.modal-foot{ padding:16px 22px; border-top:1px solid var(--border); display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; gap:10px; position:sticky; bottom:0; background:var(--surface); }
   277→
   278→/* Toasts */
   279→.toast-wrap{ position:fixed; top:18px; right:18px; z-index:200; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; max-width:340px; }
   280→.toast{ background:var(--ink); color:#fff; padding:12px 15px; border-radius:10px; font-size:13px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-md); display:flex; gap:9px; align-items:flex-start; animation:toastin .18s ease; line-height:1.4; }
   281→.toast.ok{ background:#153B27; }
   282→.toast.err{ background:#4A1512; }
   283→@keyframes toastin{ from{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(-6px);} to{ opacity:1; transform:none;} }
   284→
   285→.qa-item{ border:1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius:var(--radius); padding:16px; margin-bottom:12px; background:var(--surface-2); }
   286→.qa-item .qa-head{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:10px; }
   287→.qa-item .qa-num{ width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:7px; background:var(--navy); color:#fff; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:800; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex:0 0 auto; }
   288→.qa-opt{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; padding:9px 10px; border:1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius:9px; margin-bottom:7px; background:var(--surface); }
   289→.qa-opt input{ width:auto !important; }
   290→
   291→.quiz-runner{ max-width:720px; margin:0 auto; }
   292→.quiz-timer{ position:sticky; top:78px; z-index:5; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; background:var(--surface); border:1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius:12px; padding:10px 16px; margin-bottom:16px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); }
   293→.quiz-timer .t{ font-weight:800; font-size:16px; color:var(--navy); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
   294→.quiz-opt{ display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:11px; padding:13px 14px; border:1.5px solid var(--border); border-radius:11px; margin-bottom:9px; cursor:pointer; background:var(--surface); transition:border-color .12s, background .12s; }
   295→.quiz-opt:hover{ border-color:#B9C6DC; }
   296→.quiz-opt.picked{ border-color:var(--navy); background:#EEF2F9; }
   297→.quiz-opt input{ margin-top:2px; }
   298→.progress-bar{ height:7px; background:var(--border); border-radius:20px; overflow:hidden; }
   299→.progress-bar > i{ display:block; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold), var(--gold-2)); border-radius:20px; }
   300→
   301→.chart-box{ position:relative; height:260px; }
   302→.chart-box.short{ height:190px; }
   303→
   304→/* Cetak / Laporan */
   305→.report-sheet{ background:#fff; max-width:800px; margin:0 auto; padding:34px 38px; }
   306→.report-head{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; border-bottom:3px solid var(--navy); padding-bottom:14px; margin-bottom:20px; }
   307→.report-head .ring{ width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%; background:conic-gradient(from -40deg, var(--gold) 0deg, var(--gold-2) 110deg, var(--navy) 111deg, var(--navy) 360deg); display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center; flex:0 0 auto;}
   308→.report-head .ring span{ width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%; background:var(--navy); color:var(--gold-2); display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center; font-weight:800; font-size:15px; }
   309→.report-head h2{ font-size:18px; }
   310→.report-head .sc{ font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); }
   311→.report-meta{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:6px 24px; font-size:12.5px; margin-bottom:18px; }
   312→.report-meta div b{ color:var(--ink-2); }
   313→.report-section-title{ font-size:12.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.06em; color:var(--navy); font-weight:800; margin:20px 0 8px; border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--gold-soft); padding-bottom:5px; }
   314→.report-sheet table{ font-size:12.5px; }
   315→.report-sheet thead th{ background:var(--surface-2); }
   316→.report-foot{ margin-top:30px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:12px; color:var(--muted); }
   317→.report-sign{ text-align:center; }
   318→.report-sign .line{ margin-top:56px; border-top:1px solid var(--ink); padding-top:4px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink); }
   319→
   320→#printArea{ position:absolute; left:-99999px; top:0; width:800px; }
   321→@media print{
   322→  body *{ visibility:hidden; }
   323→  #printArea, #printArea *{ visibility:visible; }
   324→  #printArea{ position:absolute; left:0; top:0; width:100%; }
   325→  .no-print{ display:none !important; }
   326→  .report-sheet{ padding:0; max-width:100%; }
   327→}
   328→
   329→/* Responsive */
   330→@media (max-width:960px){
   331→  .sidebar{ position:fixed; left:0; top:0; height:100vh; transform:translateX(-100%); transition:transform .2s ease; box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg); }
   332→  .sidebar.open{ transform:translateX(0); }
   333→  .menu-toggle{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
   334→  .content{ padding:18px 16px 60px; }
   335→  .topbar{ padding:12px 16px; }
   336→  .sidebar-overlay{ position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(9,14,26,.45); z-index:19; }
   337→}
   338→@media (max-width:640px){
   339→  .auth-card{ padding:28px 22px 24px; }
   340→  .field-row{ flex-direction:column; gap:0; }
   341→}
   342→
   343→</style>
   344→</head>
   345→<body>
   346→<div id="toastWrap" class="toast-wrap" aria-live="polite"></div>
   347→
   348→<!-- ======================= LAYAR PENGATURAN AWAL ======================= -->
   349→<section id="screenSetup" class="full-screen hidden">
   350→  <div class="brand-orb"></div>
   351→  <div class="auth-card">
   352→    <div class="auth-mark">
   353→      <div class="ring"><span>SM</span></div>
   354→      <div class="word"><b>SIMANTAP</b><small>Situs Mandiri Terintegrasi Aplikasi Pembelajaran</small></div>
   355→    </div>
   356→    <h2 class="auth-title">Pengaturan Awal</h2>
   357→    <p class="auth-sub">Hubungkan aplikasi ini ke Google Sheet yang menjadi basis data bersama. Cukup dilakukan sekali per komputer.</p>
   358→
   359→    <div class="setup-info">
   360→      <b>Belum punya alamat server?</b>
   361→      Buka Google Sheet basis data Anda → Extensions → Apps Script → tempel kode <b>Code.gs</b> yang disediakan →
   362→      jalankan fungsi <b>initDatabase</b> sekali → Deploy → New deployment → tipe <b>Web app</b>, akses <b>Anyone</b> →
   363→      salin URL yang berakhiran <b>/exec</b> lalu tempel di bawah ini.
   364→    </div>
   365→
   366→    <div id="setupError"></div>
   367→
   368→    <form id="formSetup">
   369→      <div class="field">
   370→        <label for="inpBackendUrl">Alamat Server (Web App URL)</label>
   371→        <input id="inpBackendUrl" type="url" placeholder="https://script.google.com/macros/s/xxxxx/exec" required autocomplete="off" />
   372→        <div class="field-hint">Tersimpan hanya di komputer ini. Data sesungguhnya tetap berada di Google Sheet bersama.</div>
   373→      </div>
   374→      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-block" id="btnSetupSubmit">Uji Sambungan &amp; Lanjutkan</button>
   375→    </form>
   376→    <div class="auth-foot">Tim Kerja 4 — Model dan Media · BBGTK Sulawesi Selatan · Kemendikdasmen</div>
   377→  </div>
   378→</section>
   379→
   380→<!-- ============================ LAYAR LOGIN ============================ -->
   381→<section id="screenLogin" class="full-screen hidden">
   382→  <div class="brand-orb"></div>
   383→  <div class="auth-card">
   384→    <div class="auth-mark">
   385→      <div class="ring"><span>SM</span></div>
   386→      <div class="word"><b>SIMANTAP</b><small id="loginSchoolName">Situs Mandiri Terintegrasi Aplikasi Pembelajaran</small></div>
   387→    </div>
   388→    <h2 class="auth-title">Masuk ke Akun Anda</h2>
   389→    <p class="auth-sub">Untuk guru, siswa, orang tua, dan admin sekolah.</p>
   390→
   391→    <div id="loginError"></div>
   392→
   393→    <form id="formLogin">
   394→      <div class="field">
   395→        <label for="inpUsername">Username</label>
   396→        <input id="inpUsername" type="text" autocomplete="username" required />
   397→      </div>
   398→      <div class="field">
   399→        <label for="inpPassword">Password</label>
   400→        <input id="inpPassword" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required />
   401→      </div>
   402→      <button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary btn-block" id="btnLoginSubmit">Masuk</button>
   403→    </form>
   404→    <div class="auth-switch"><button type="button" id="btnGantiServer">Ganti alamat server</button></div>
   405→    <div class="auth-foot">Tim Kerja 4 — Model dan Media · BBGTK Sulawesi Selatan · Kemendikdasmen</div>
   406→  </div>
   407→</section>
   408→
   409→<!-- ============================ APP SHELL =============================== -->
   410→<div id="appShell" class="app-shell hidden">
   411→  <div class="sidebar-overlay hidden" id="sidebarOverlay"></div>
   412→  <aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">
   413→    <div class="sb-brand">
   414→      <div class="ring"><span>SM</span></div>
   415→      <div class="word"><b>SIMANTAP</b><small id="sbSchoolName">Situs Mandiri</small></div>
   416→    </div>
   417→    <div class="sb-school" id="sbSchoolBox"></div>
   418→    <nav class="sb-nav" id="sbNav"></nav>
   419→    <div class="sb-foot">
   420→      <div class="sb-user">
   421→        <div class="av" id="sbAvatar">?</div>
   422→        <div class="who"><b id="sbUserName">—</b><small id="sbUserRole">—</small></div>
   423→      </div>
   424→      <div class="sb-foot-actions">
   425→        <button type="button" id="btnAkun">Akun</button>
   426→        <button type="button" id="btnLogout">Keluar</button>
   427→      </div>
   428→    </div>
   429→  </aside>
   430→
   431→  <div class="main">
   432→    <header class="topbar">
   433→      <button class="menu-toggle btn-ghost" id="btnMenuToggle" aria-label="Buka menu">
   434→        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"/><line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"/></svg>
   435→      </button>
   436→      <div>
   437→        <h1 id="pageTitle">Beranda</h1>
   438→        <div class="sub" id="pageSub"></div>
   439→      </div>
   440→      <div class="spacer"></div>
   441→      <div id="topbarExtra"></div>
   442→    </header>
   443→    <main class="content" id="viewRoot"></main>
   444→  </div>
   445→</div>
   446→
   447→<div id="modalRoot"></div>
   448→<div id="printArea"></div>

   467→<script>
   468→/* ============================================================
   469→   SIMANTAP — Inti Aplikasi (konfigurasi, API, utilitas UI)
   470→   ============================================================ */
   471→(function (global) {
   472→  'use strict';
   473→
   474→  var STORE_URL = 'simantap_backend_url';
   475→  var STORE_SESSION = 'simantap_session';
   476→
   477→  var APP = {
   478→    backendUrl: localStorage.getItem(STORE_URL) || '',
   479→    session: null,
   480→    settings: {},
   481→    cache: { kelas: null, mapel: null },
   482→    view: null,
   483→    params: {},
   484→    sidebarNav: []
   485→  };
   486→  global.APP = APP;
   487→
   488→  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- utils
   489→  function escapeHtml(s) {
   490→    if (s === null || s === undefined) return '';
   491→    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, function (c) {
   492→      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' }[c];
   493→    });
   494→  }
   495→  function fmtNum(n, d) {
   496→    if (n === null || n === undefined || n === '' || isNaN(Number(n))) return '—';
   497→    return Number(n).toFixed(d === undefined ? 1 : d).replace(/\.0$/, '');
   498→  }
   499→  function fmtDate(s) {
   500→    if (!s) return '—';
   501→    try {
   502→      var d = new Date(s);
   503→      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(s);
   504→      var bulan = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'Mei', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Agu', 'Sep', 'Okt', 'Nov', 'Des'];
   505→      return d.getDate() + ' ' + bulan[d.getMonth()] + ' ' + d.getFullYear();
   506→    } catch (e) { return String(s); }
   507→  }
   508→  function fmtDateTime(s) {
   509→    if (!s) return '—';
   510→    try {
   511→      var d = new Date(s);
   512→      if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return String(s);
   513→      return fmtDate(s) + ', ' + ('0' + d.getHours()).slice(-2) + ':' + ('0' + d.getMinutes()).slice(-2);
   514→    } catch (e) { return String(s); }
   515→  }
   516→  function initials(name) {
   517→    if (!name) return '?';
   518→    var parts = String(name).trim().split(/\s+/);
   519→    if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();

   619→  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- toast
   620→  function toast(msg, type) {
   621→    var wrap = document.getElementById('toastWrap');
   622→    var el = document.createElement('div');
   623→    el.className = 'toast' + (type === 'ok' ? ' ok' : type === 'err' ? ' err' : '');

   625→    el.innerHTML = ic + '<div>' + escapeHtml(msg) + '</div>';
   626→    wrap.appendChild(el);
   627→    setTimeout(function () {
   628→      el.style.opacity = '0'; el.style.transition = 'opacity .25s';
   629→      setTimeout(function () { el.remove(); }, 260);
   630→    }, 3600);
   631→  }
   632→  global.toast = toast;

   634→  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- modal
   635→  function openModal(opts) {
   636→    var root = document.getElementById('modalRoot');
   637→    root.innerHTML =
   638→      '<div class="modal-backdrop" id="mdBackdrop"><div class="modal ' + (opts.wide ? 'modal-wide' : '') + '">' +
   639→      '<div class="modal-head"><div><h3>' + opts.title + '</h3>' + (opts.desc ? '<div class="desc">' + opts.desc + '</div>' : '') + '</div>' +
   640→      '<button class="modal-close" id="mdClose" type="button">' + icon('x', 16) + '</button></div>' +
   641→      '<div class="modal-body">' + opts.body + '</div>' +
   642→      (opts.foot ? '<div class="modal-foot">' + opts.foot + '</div>' : '') +
   643→      '</div></div>';
   644→    document.getElementById('mdClose').onclick = closeModal;
   645→    document.getElementById('mdBackdrop').addEventListener('click', function (e) {
   646→      if (e.target.id === 'mdBackdrop') closeModal();
   647→    });
   648→    if (opts.onMount) opts.onMount(root);
   649→  }
   650→  function closeModal() { document.getElementById('modalRoot').innerHTML = ''; }
   651→  global.openModal = openModal;
   652→  global.closeModal = closeModal;

   654→  function confirmDialog(opts) {

   656→      openModal({
   657→        title: opts.title || 'Konfirmasi',
   658→        body: '<p style="font-size:14px;color:var(--ink-2);line-height:1.55">' + escapeHtml(opts.message || '') + '</p>',
   659→        foot: '<button class="btn btn-ghost" id="cfNo" type="button">Batal</button>' +
   660→          '<button class="btn ' + (opts.danger ? 'btn-danger' : 'btn-primary') + '" id="cfYes" type="button">' + (opts.confirmLabel || 'Ya, lanjutkan') + '</button>'
   661→      });
   662→      document.getElementById('cfNo').onclick = function () { closeModal(); resolve(false); };
   663→      document.getElementById('cfYes').onclick = function () { closeModal(); resolve(true); };
   664→    });
   665→  }

   668→  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- API
   669→  function callAPI(action, payload) {
   670→    if (!APP.backendUrl) return Promise.reject(new Error('Alamat server belum diatur.'));
   671→    var body = JSON.stringify({ action: action, payload: payload || {}, token: APP.session ? APP.session.token : '' });
   672→    return fetch(APP.backendUrl, { method: 'POST', body: body })
   673→      .catch(function () { throw new Error('Tidak dapat terhubung ke server. Periksa koneksi internet atau alamat server.'); })
   674→      .then(function (r) { return r.text(); })
   675→      .then(function (txt) {
   676→        var json;
   677→        try { json = JSON.parse(txt); }
   678→        catch (e) { throw new Error('Respons server tidak valid. Pastikan alamat server & deployment sudah benar.'); }
   679→        if (!json.ok) throw new Error(json.error || 'Terjadi kesalahan pada server.');
   680→        return json.data;
   681→      });
   682→  }
   683→  global.callAPI = callAPI;

   685→  function setBusy(btn, busy, busyLabel) {
   686→    if (!btn) return;
   687→    if (busy) {
   688→      btn.dataset._label = btn.innerHTML;
   689→      btn.disabled = true;
   690→      btn.innerHTML = '<span style="display:inline-block;width:14px;height:14px;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);border-top-color:#fff;border-radius:50%;animation:spin .6s linear infinite"></span> ' + (busyLabel || 'Memproses…');
   691→    } else {
   692→      btn.disabled = false;
   693→      if (btn.dataset._label) btn.innerHTML = btn.dataset._label;
   694→    }
   695→  }
   696→  global.setBusy = setBusy;

   703→  global.saveSetupUrl = function (url) { localStorage.setItem(STORE_URL, url); APP.backendUrl = url; };
   704→  global.clearSetupUrl = function () { localStorage.removeItem(STORE_URL); APP.backendUrl = ''; };
   705→  global.saveSession = function (s) { localStorage.setItem(STORE_SESSION, JSON.stringify(s)); APP.session = s; };
   706→  global.loadSessionFromStorage = function () {

   715→  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- ring gauge (SVG progress)
   716→  global.ringGauge = function (pct, size, opts) {
   717→    opts = opts || {};
   718→    pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(pct) || 0));
   719→    size = size || 64;
   720→    var stroke = opts.stroke || 7;
   721→    var r = (size - stroke) / 2;
   722→    var c = 2 * Math.PI * r;
   723→    var offset = c - (pct / 100) * c;
   724→    var color = opts.color || (pct >= (opts.threshold || 75) ? 'var(--ok)' : pct >= (opts.threshold || 75) - 20 ? 'var(--gold)' : 'var(--bad)');
   725→    return '<div class="ring-gauge" style="width:' + size + 'px;height:' + size + 'px">' +
   726→      '<svg width="' + size + '" height="' + size + '">' +
   727→      '<circle cx="' + size / 2 + '" cy="' + size / 2 + '" r="' + r + '" stroke="var(--border)" stroke-width="' + stroke + '" fill="none"/>' +
   728→      '<circle cx="' + size / 2 + '" cy="' + size / 2 + '" r="' + r + '" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="' + stroke + '" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-dasharray="' + c + '" stroke-dashoffset="' + offset + '" style="transition:stroke-dashoffset .6s ease"/>' +
   729→      '</svg><div class="center"><b>' + fmtNum(pct, 0) + '</b>' + (opts.label ? '<small>' + opts.label + '</small>' : '') + '</div></div>';
   730→  };

   787→  function buildReportHtml(data) {

  1133→      return '<div class="field"><label>' + f.label + '</label><select name="' + f.name + '" ' + (f.required ? 'required' : '') + '>' +
  1134→        '<option value="">— Pilih —</option>' +
  1135→        opts.map(function (o) { return '<option value="' + o.value + '" ' + (String(val) === String(o.value) ? 'selected' : '') + '>' + U.escapeHtml(o.label) + '</option>'; }).join('') +
  1136→        '</select></div>';
  1137→    }
  1138→    if (f.type === 'checkbox') {
  1139→      return '<div class="field"><label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px"><input type="checkbox" name="' + f.name + '" ' + (val ? 'checked' : '') + ' style="width:auto"/> ' + f.label + '</label></div>';
  1140→    }
  1141→    if (f.type === 'textarea') {
  1142→      return '<div class="field"><label>' + f.label + '</label><textarea name="' + f.name + '" rows="3"' + (f.placeholder ? ' placeholder="' + U.escapeHtml(f.placeholder) + '"' : '') + '>' + U.escapeHtml(val) + '</textarea></div>';
  1143→    }
  1144→    return '<div class="field"><label>' + f.label + '</label><input type="' + (f.type || 'text') + '" name="' + f.name + '" value="' + U.escapeHtml(val) + '" ' + (f.required ? 'required' : '') + (f.placeholder ? ' placeholder="' + U.escapeHtml(f.placeholder) + '"' : '') + '/></div>';
  1145→  }
  1146→  function readFieldsValues(fields, form) {
  1147→    var out = {};
  1148→    fields.forEach(function (f) {
  1149→      var el = form.elements[f.name];

  1152→    });
  1153→    return out;
  1154→  }

  1159→  function crudTableView(opts) {

  1161→      title: opts.title, sub: opts.sub,
  1162→      render: function () {
  1163→        return (opts.preload ? opts.preload() : Promise.resolve()).then(function () {
  1164→          return callAPI(opts.listAction, {});
  1165→        }).then(function (rows) { renderList(rows); });
  1166→
  1167→        function renderList(rows) {

  1169→            '<button class="btn btn-primary" id="crudAdd">' + icon('plus', 16) + ' ' + (opts.addLabel || 'Tambah') + '</button></div>' +
  1170→            '<div class="card"><div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr>' +
  1171→            opts.columns.map(function (c) { return '<th>' + c.label + '</th>'; }).join('') + '<th style="width:90px"></th>' +
  1172→            '</tr></thead><tbody id="crudBody"></tbody></table></div></div>';
  1173→          U.qs('#viewRoot').innerHTML = html;
  1174→          paint(rows);
  1175→          U.qs('#crudAdd').onclick = function () { openForm(null); };
  1176→          U.qs('#crudSearch').addEventListener('input', U.debounce(function (e) {
  1177→            var q = e.target.value.toLowerCase();
  1178→            paint(rows.filter(function (r) { return JSON.stringify(r).toLowerCase().indexOf(q) !== -1; }));
  1179→          }, 180));
  1180→
  1181→          function paint(list) {
  1182→            if (!list.length) { U.qs('#crudBody').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="' + (opts.columns.length + 1) + '"><div class="empty-state">' + icon('info', 26) + '<h4>Belum ada data</h4><p>Klik tombol Tambah untuk mulai mengisi.</p></div></td></tr>'; return; }
  1183→            U.qs('#crudBody').innerHTML = list.map(function (r) {
  1184→              return '<tr data-id="' + r.id + '">' +
  1185→                opts.columns.map(function (c) { return '<td>' + (c.render ? c.render(r) : U.escapeHtml(r[c.key] == null || r[c.key] === '' ? '—' : r[c.key])) + '</td>'; }).join('') +
  1186→                '<td><div class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm btn-icon act-edit" title="Ubah">' + icon('edit', 14) + '</button><button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm btn-icon act-del" title="Hapus">' + icon('trash', 14) + '</button></div></td>' +
  1187→                '</tr>';
  1188→            }).join('');
  1189→            U.qsa('.act-edit', U.qs('#crudBody')).forEach(function (btn) {
  1190→              btn.onclick = function () { var id = btn.closest('tr').dataset.id; var row = rows.find(function (r) { return String(r.id) === String(id); }); openForm(row); };
  1191→            });
  1192→            U.qsa('.act-del', U.qs('#crudBody')).forEach(function (btn) {
  1193→              btn.onclick = function () {

  1195→                confirmDialog({ title: 'Hapus data?', message: opts.deleteMessage || 'Data yang dihapus tidak dapat dikembalikan.', danger: true, confirmLabel: 'Ya, Hapus' }).then(function (ok) {
  1196→                  if (!ok) return;
  1197→                  callAPI(opts.deleteAction, { id: id }).then(function () { toast('Data dihapus.', 'ok'); navigate(APP.view); }).catch(function (err) { toast(err.message, 'err'); });
  1198→                });
  1199→              };
  1200→            });
  1201→          }
  1202→        }
  1203→
  1204→        function openForm(row) {
  1205→          var fields = typeof opts.fields === 'function' ? opts.fields() : opts.fields;
  1206→          openModal({
  1207→            title: row ? 'Ubah ' + opts.singular : 'Tambah ' + opts.singular,

  1209→            foot: '<button class="btn btn-ghost" type="button" id="crudCancel">Batal</button><button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" id="crudSave">Simpan</button>'
  1210→          });
  1211→          U.qs('#crudCancel').onclick = closeModal;
  1212→          U.qs('#crudSave').onclick = function () {

  1549→        '<h3 style="margin-bottom:4px">Pulihkan dari Cadangan</h3><p style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.5"><b>Perhatian:</b> memulihkan cadangan akan MENIMPA seluruh data yang ada saat ini dengan isi berkas cadangan.   1656→  VIEWS.guru_nilai = {
  1657→    title: 'Input Nilai', sub: 'Catat dan kelola nilai siswa per kelas',

  1660→
  1661→      function renderShell() {

  1663→          '<div class="select-chip"><select id="jenisFilter"><option value="">Semua Jenis</option>' + JENIS_OPTS.map(function (j) { return '<option value="' + j.value + '">' + j.label + '</option>'; }).join('') + '</select></div>' +
  1664→          '<div class="spacer"></div>' +
  1665→          '<button class="btn btn-ghost" id="btnBulkNilai">' + icon('grid', 15) + ' Input per Kelas</button>' +
  1666→          '<button class="btn btn-primary" id="btnTambahNilai">' + icon('plus', 16) + ' Tambah Nilai</button></div>' +
  1667→          '<div class="card"><div class="table-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Siswa</th><th>Jenis</th><th>Nilai</th><th>Tanggal</th><th>Catatan</th><th style="width:70px"></th></tr></thead><tbody id="nilaiBody"></tbody></table></div></div>';
  1668→        U.qs('#viewRoot').innerHTML = html;

  1676→
  1677→      function loadData() {
  1678→        var a = guruState.ampuList[guruState.current];
  1679→        U.qs('#nilaiBody').innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="empty-state">' + icon('refresh', 22) + '<h4>Memuat…</h4></div></td></tr>';
  1680→        Promise.all([callAPI('guru_getSiswaByKelas', { kelas_id: a.kelas_id }), callAPI('guru_getNilai', { kelas_id: a.kelas_id, mapel_id: a.mapel_id })])
  1681→          .then(function (res) { paint(res[0], res[1]); });
  1682→      }
  1683→
  1684→      function paint(siswaList, nilaiList) {
  1685→        var jenis = U.qs('#jenisFilter') ? U.qs('#jenisFilter').value : '';

  1851→  var soalDraft = [];

  1869→      '<select class="soal-tipe" data-idx="' + idx + '" style="border:1.3px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;padding:6px 8px;font-family:inherit">' +
  1870→      '<option value="pg" ' + (sd.tipe === 'pg' ? 'selected' : '') + '>Pilihan Ganda</option>' +

  1873→      '<label style="font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted)">Bobot</label><input type="number" class="soal-bobot" data-idx="' + idx + '" value="' + (sd._bobot || 1) + '" min="1" style="width:56px;border:1.3px solid var(--border);border-radius:6px;padding:5px 6px"/>' +
  1874→      '<button type="button" class="btn btn-danger btn-sm btn-icon soal-del" data-idx="' + idx + '">' + icon('trash', 13) + '</button></div></div>' +
  1875→      '<textarea class="soal-pertanyaan" data-idx="' + idx + '" rows="2" placeholder="Tulis pertanyaan…" style="width:100%;border:1.3px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;font-family:inherit;font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:10px">' + U.escapeHtml(sd._text || '') + '</textarea>';

  1881→          '<input type="text" class="opt-text" data-idx="' + idx + '" placeholder="Pilihan ' + String.fromCharCode(65 + i) + '" value="' + U.escapeHtml(pilihan[i] || '') + '" style="flex:1;border:none;background:transparent;font-size:13.5px;font-family:inherit"/></div>';
  1882→      }

  1884→        (sd.pilihanCount > 2 ? '<button type="button" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm opt-del" data-idx="' + idx + '">' + icon('trash', 13) + ' Hapus Pilihan Terakhir</button>' : '') + '</div>' +
  1885→        '<div class="field-hint">Klik bulatan di samping pilihan untuk menandai jawaban benar.</div>';
